title: Unit 21 Consolidation: They Say, One Knows and Softer Claims
goal: Review plural impersonals, uno, nominalisation, hace falta que and hedging, and read a short text about Céspedes and El pozo.

items: I can use a plural verb, se or uno to speak about unnamed people.
I can turn a verb clause into a noun phrase to leave the doer out.
I can use hace falta que, basta con que and urge que, and soften a claim with parece que.
I can read a short text about Céspedes and El pozo.
